newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices eased marginally at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said on Monday.
Brighter and medium BP1s eased by 5-9 U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s were irregularly easier by 2-5 cents. Medium were irregular while Brighter DUST 1s were firm up to nine cents.
Most descriptions in the secondary catalogues were dearer.
There was good support from Pakistan and strong enquiry from Egypt and Britain.
